He further submits that insofar as the offence under Section 406 is concerned, the only allegation is with regard to entrustment.

There is no mention made in the complaint that at any point of time,
the respondent no.2/complainant made demand for the return of dowry articles entrusted by her to the accused persons, therefore, Section 406 IPC is not attached to present petition.

In support of his contention, he has placed reliance on the decision of the Supreme Court in Kamlesh Kalra vs.

7. Let status report be filed before the next date.

9. Learned senior counsel for the petitioners submits that the address of the petitioner nos.2 and 3 mentioned in the memo of parties has not been correctly stated.
He seeks to file fresh memo of parties giving correct address of the said petitioners.

10. Let the needful be done within a period of one week from today.
